CustomFunction.Name: cdStringParamDisplay
CustomFunction.Text:
Function cdStringParamDisplay (param () As String Range, title As String)
dim paramcount as number dim increment as number dim outputd as string dim outputr as string
paramcount = count(param) Do While paramcount > increment increment = increment + 1 if maximum(param (increment)) <> minimum(param (increment)) _ then outputr = outputr + minimum(param (increment)) + " to " + maximum( param (increment)) + "\par " _ else outputd = outputd + minimum( param (increment)) + "\par " _ Loop
